text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In this mock race...
...I couldn't chase them down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I need to restructure the menu around footwork sharpness.
...The current menu needs a complete overhaul.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Put a higher ratio on leg strength and stamina.
To gauge the pace distribution leading up to the final push,
let's also increase the number of side-by-side runs――"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I need to read the textbook again. What applies now... must be different from before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—after overworking herself to the bone,
she ended up staying up late into the night.
